answer: Proof of stake serves as a cryptographic kernel for Sybil resistance in agent economies, requiring agents to commit capital to validate transitions. This mechanism creates a mirror of physical resource scarcity within a digital landscape, ensuring that influence is tied to tangible equity. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces a prohibitive cost, as every additional node acts like a structural timber, requiring proportional financial outlays that render mass sybil fabrication economically irrational.
